Ordinance No. ORD-30-06222026 Adopted 6/22/26 AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE CODE OF THOMASVILLE, GEORGIA, BY AMENDING CHAPTER 2, CAPTIONED "ADMINISTRATION", ARTICLE V., CAPTIONED "RETIREMENT", DIVISION 3., CAPTIONED "PENSIONS; DEFINED BENEFIT", BY (1) AMENDING SECTION 2-221., CAPTIONED "DEFINITIONS.", SO AS TO ADD A NEW DEFINITION FOR "RETIRED MEMBER" AND SO AS TO EXPAND DEFINITION OF "TERMINATION OF EMPLOYMENT"; AND, (2) AMENDING SECTION 2-222., CAPTIONED "PENSION BOARD OF TRUSTEES-DEFINED BENEFIT; ESTABLISHED, COMPOSITION, TERMS OFFICERS.", BY AMENDING TEXT OF PARAGRAPHS (A) AND (B); AND, (3) AMENDING SECTION 2-228., CAPTIONED "REFUND OF CONTRIBUTIONS AND VESTED BENEFITS." BY STRIKING IN ITS ENTIRETY SUBPARAGRAPH (A)(2); AND, (4) STRIKING IN ITS ENTIRETY SECTION 2-234 – 2-259, CAPTIONED "RESERVED"; AND, (5) ADDING A NEW SECTION 2-234., CAPTIONED "MEDICAL BENEFITS AND CONTINUATION OF MEDICAL BENEFITS FOR CLASS A, B, AND C PLAN MEMBERS."; AND, (6) ADDING A NEW SECTION 2-235 – 2-259, CAPTIONED "RESERVED"; AND, (7) REPEALING ALL ORDINANCES IN CONFLICT HEREWITH; AND (8) PROVIDING FOR THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF THIS ORDINANCE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
